equations.title: finite exact polynomial star product
equations.equation: f star g = sum_k (i hbar/2)^k Lambda^k(f,g)/k!
equations.assumptions: Polynomial symbols; expansion terminates; coefficients in Q[i][hbar]; resource guards apply.

equations.title: exact Moyal correction tower
equations.equation: [f,g]_star/(i hbar) = {f,g} - hbar^2 Lambda^3(f,g)/24 + hbar^4 Lambda^5(f,g)/1920 - ...
equations.assumptions: Polynomial symbols and the retained flat symplectic convention; central and noncentral defects remain distinct.

equations.title: affine symplectic star covariance
equations.equation: (f composed Phi) star (g composed Phi) = (f star g) composed Phi; Phi(z)=Mz+b, M^T J M=J
equations.assumptions: Affine symplectic ordinary pullback; exact finite covariance checks and standard bidifferential argument.

equations.title: nonlinear covariance obstruction
equations.equation: Phi(q,p)=(q,p+q^2), f=p^2,g=p: star-pullback defect=-hbar^2/2; Poisson defect=0
equations.assumptions: Explicit nonlinear symplectic shear under ordinary substitution in the unchanged flat star product.

equations.title: monomial Hahn coefficient
equations.equation: S_k(a,b,c,d)=sum_(r=0)^k (-1)^r binom(k,r)(a)_(k-r)(b)_r(c)_r(d)_(k-r)
equations.assumptions: Nonnegative integer exponents; falling factorials vanish beyond their argument.

equations.title: complete finite monomial exactness gate
equations.equation: exact iff S_k=0 for every odd k in {3,5,...,kappa}; kappa=min(a,d)+min(b,c)
equations.assumptions: Formal polynomial equality, not a small numerical residual; every active odd order is retained.

equations.title: classified rays and higher-order decoys
equations.assumptions: r>=1; four kappa=4 ray families and reversals implemented. Global absence of higher-kappa nonzero-Poisson exactness is conjectural.

equations.title: cyclic obstruction invariant
equations.equation: omega_k(a,b,c)=exp(2pi i k a floor((b+c)/n)/n); product_j omega_k(1,j,1)=exp(2pi i k/n)
equations.assumptions: Standard representatives in Z/n; phases represented exactly modulo integers.

equations.title: constructive cyclic extension repair
equations.equation: B(a,b)=exp(2pi i k(a mod n)floor(b/n)/n) on Z/n^2; dB=q*omega_k
equations.assumptions: q:Z/n^2->Z/n; explicit finite replay; no minimum-extension or arbitrary-group claim.

equations.title: sector-connectivity reach algebra
equations.equation: generated_star_algebra(direct_sum_c End(V_c),P)=End(V) iff graph(P_cd!=0) is connected
equations.assumptions: Full matrix block algebras and self-adjoint projector P; exact sector graph and small matrix-algebra replay; supplied physical access remains an assumption.

equations.title: exact conductor-level transport
equations.equation: M=dL: F_M iota_d=pi*F_L; F_M pi*=d iota_d F_L; T_M iota_d=iota_d T_L^d
equations.assumptions: Unnormalized Fourier F_N[j,k]=zeta_N^(jk), specified chirp and support/pullback maps; normalized square-root factors stated separately.

equations.title: twisted CRT factorization
equations.equation: F_(LK) -> F_L^(K) tensor F_K^(L); T_(LK) -> T_L^K tensor T_K^L
equations.assumptions: Coprime L,K; CRT section (a,b)->Ka+Lb; twists retained rather than silently erased.

equations.title: finite coupled-lattice theta numerator
equations.equation: sum_(a>=0) zeta^Q(a) x^|a| = N_(C,L)(x)/(1-x^L)^r; Q(a)=a^T C a/2
equations.assumptions: Integral symmetric C with even diagonal; finite residue numerator; no automatic modular-form claim.

equations.title: boundary-twisted theta reciprocity
equations.equation: x^(r(L-1))N(1/x)=zeta^Q((L-1)1) sum_rho zeta^(Q(rho)+(C1).rho) x^|rho|
equations.assumptions: Same finite lattice conventions; boundary character must be included.

equations.title: cancellation-conditioned summation bound
equations.equation: kappa_sum=sum|t_j|/|sum t_j|; relative error<=gamma_(N-1) kappa_sum; gamma_m=mu/(1-mu)
equations.assumptions: Nonzero exact-input sum; recursive p-bit rounding and (N-1)u<1. Input/evaluation/model errors are separate; zero sums use absolute bounds.

equations.title: adaptive precision and uncertainty-aware comparison
equations.equation: total_error=rounding_bound+evaluation_error+input_error+model_error; separated lower/upper intervals certify a leader
equations.assumptions: Explicit error budgets; increasing arithmetic precision cannot remove fixed external uncertainty.

equations.title: colored weighted finite-path population
equations.equation: Z_n=sum_(paths gamma length n) product_e w_type(e); finite row-sum domination bounds every starting row
equations.assumptions: Declared finite graph, nonnegative exact weights and explicit walk/self-avoidance/chronology semantics. Transfer to an external infinite model requires a domination map.

equations.title: block contraction tail certificate
equations.equation: rho=norm(W^B)_infinity<1 implies block-geometric all-walk domination
equations.assumptions: Finite nonnegative weighted transition matrix; intermediate block residues and constants retained; does not assume monotonic root bounds.

equations.title: complete outcome-channel conservation
equations.equation: sum_beta p_beta=1; channels=exact disjoint-union frame disjoint-union repeat disjoint-union silent
equations.assumptions: Declared exact probability partition; frame corrections and device rates are supplied, not inferred.

equations.title: finite repeat failure and cost
equations.equation: p_fail(R)=p_silent sum_(j=0)^(R-1) p_repeat^j + p_exhaust p_repeat^R
equations.assumptions: Independent identical attempts and explicit exhaustion cost/error convention; exact finite depth optimization under the stated strict threshold.

equations.title: isolated circular logarithmic period
equations.equation: integral_(w=r exp(it), t=0..2pi) log(w) dw = 2pi i r; charge c multiplies the coefficient by c
equations.assumptions: Specified circular representative, start, orientation and continuously tracked branch; declared divisor geometry must isolate one charge. Not a radius-independent topological period.

equations.title: character-twisted visible-ray Dirichlet identity
equations.equation: sum_(n>=1) phi(n)chi(n)n^(-s)=L(s-1,chi)/L(s,chi), Re(s)>2
equations.assumptions: Dirichlet character with exact cyclotomic values; finite coefficient identity replayed independently by formal Dirichlet division. Irrational phase twists remain separate.

equations.title: norm-unit coordinate recurrence
equations.equation: z_(n+2)=2a z_(n+1)-z_n for multiplication by a+b sqrt(D), norm one
equations.assumptions: Each coordinate of the supplied seed orbit; invertibility retained modulo composite moduli.

equations.title: Pell history binomial fibers
equations.equation: accepted(H)=sum_(k=0)^H binom(H,k) 1_accept((2k-H) mod period)
equations.assumptions: Advance/retreat words on the supplied modular seed orbit; original words retain multiplicity, and original-domain reconstruction requires its additional checks.

equations.title: positive-unit-class asymptotic normalization
equations.equation: A(N)=(sum_positive_classes |J_class|/p_class) log(N)/log(epsilon)+O(1)
equations.assumptions: Deduplicated positive embedding classes normalized in [1,epsilon), reconstruction residues and distinct nonnegative inputs; signed y witnesses do not double the population.

equations.title: bounded invariant-law discovery
equations.equation: sum_nu c_nu NF_I(A^nu1 B^nu2 C^nu3 D^nu4)=0, excluding relations identically zero on the full family
equations.assumptions: Exact Groebner normal forms and a bounded weighted-degree search; all-degree completeness is not claimed.

equations.title: recovered active quintic partner
equations.assumptions: Exact archived pair and active dimension replay; rounded complex Mobius matching is not promoted to an exact one-orbit proof.

equations.title: torus skein product and central multiples
equations.equation: e_(p,q)e_(r,s)=A^(ps-qr)e_(p+r,q+s)+A^(-(ps-qr))e_(p-r,q-s)
equations.assumptions: Torus convention e_v=e_-v; exact roots of unity, no unsupported coordinate reduction modulo L; L-divisible curves central at A^(2L)=1.

equations.title: integer-height half-lift parity
equations.equation: sigma_(L+1)(d_lambda)/d_lambda=(-1)^<lambda,2rho_coroot>
equations.assumptions: Even L and integer-height sine-product convention; implements parity criterion, not a general nonsimply-laced modular-data theorem.

equations.title: silent failure asymptotic floor
equations.equation: lim_(R->infinity) p_fail(R)=p_silent/(1-p_repeat), p_repeat<1
equations.assumptions: Declared independent identical-attempt repeat model; p_repeat=1 and exhaustion conventions handled separately.

equations.title: observation-to-portfolio bound transport
equations.equation: v_i=w_i^T y; radius_i=sum_j |w_ij| error_j+model_error_i; portfolio radius=sum_i x_i radius_i
equations.assumptions: Identified target rows, exact recovery weights and deterministic supplied bounds; conservative under shared errors; exhaustive finite portfolio certificate capped at 14 original items.

equations.title: progression residue local factors
equations.equation: Residue_(s=2) sum_(n=r mod M) phi(n)n^(-s) = [product_(p divides M) p/(p+1)]/[phi(M) zeta(2)]
equations.assumptions: Reduced residue class gcd(r,M)=1; integer modulus M; exact rational factor replayed. For M=3 it is 3/(8 zeta(2)).

equations.title: exact p-bit rounding replay
equations.equation: round_p(x) is nearest p-significand-bit dyadic with ties to even; recursive sums replay each rounding step
equations.assumptions: Exact rational inputs, arbitrary exponent range; not an assertion about IEEE underflow/overflow, flags or all hardware operations.
